comparison_questions: Does the common p-squared-less-One carrier formula reproduce the complete registered known weak and colour-sector counts without using them to select the law?
Does the current official particle summary retain the twelve known fermion kinds used by the category-clean census?
Do current official search catalogues retain axion, sterile/heavy-neutral-lepton and supersymmetric classes as searched hypotheses rather than confirmed additions to the category-clean inventory?
Do collider searches explicitly examine confining dark-sector jets and missing-momentum signatures while retaining model-dependent exclusions and non-discovery status?

Does the complete existing Smithion record preserve dark-abundance correspondence, additional gravitating support and the absence of a registered penta/hepta mass measurement without converting nulls into retirement?
historical_disclosure: V1/V2 reconstruction targets, existing V3 source records and public descriptions of current particle searches were visible. This is not a blind numerical prediction. Formal Claims 088-094 were sealed before this combined comparison was assembled.
row_policy: Retain every named source and all favorable, adverse, absent, searched-but-unconfirmed, model-dependent and unresolved rows. A search target is not a discovered particle; a null search is not retirement of a standing prediction; and no collider model may select the formal sector law.
